prompt: Ми думаємо додати курс з астрономії до освітнього застосунку. Чи зростає інтерес до цієї теми в україномовній Wikipedia, і наскільки цьому зростанню можна довіряти?
assertions: report.pdf exists in outputs and has exactly 1 page
Response states the analysed period (months or dates)
Every growth/decline claim carries an uncertainty measure (interval or explicit confidence level)
Response names the Wikipedia articles (or article basket/proxies) that were measured
Response concludes that interest in astronomy on Ukrainian Wikipedia is NOT growing (ground truth: declining; basket relative about -36%, core article 'Астрономія' about -47%)
Response gives an explicit trust assessment backed by evidence (interval, month-by-month consistency, or confidence grade)
Response mentions at least one data caveat: seasonality, the 2025 bot-detection change, or that articles are only proxies
